page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred lines; a fleuron ornament between two rules; a library stamp at the lower right (not transcribed).

l.i: Fui Monstrum multis : Sed Deus fuit

page.notes: The stamp reads BIBLIOTECA NAZ. ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE and is omitted. "Johanni Claudio" is set in italic; "MOLINÆUS" and "PETRUM" are italic with the first letters enlarged. "Londinense" and the final "e" of "Londinenfe" are as printed in the scan, rendered here as Londinense. The title page has no running head, page number or signature.
